sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL;

description: Checks that each transaction record has a unique ID
sql_query: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID, COUNT(*) FROM TRANSACTIONS GROUP BY TRANSACTION_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER WHERE EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL NOT RLIKE '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$';

description: Verifies ORDER_TOTAL equals SUM(LINE_ITEM_AMOUNT) + TAX - DISCOUNT
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE ABS(ORDER_TOTAL - (SUBTOTAL + TAX - DISCOUNT)) > 0.01;

description: Ensures shipped orders cannot have created_at after shipped_at
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE SHIPPED_AT < CREATED_AT;

description: Checks if order events are ingested within 15 minutes of occurrence
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_LOG WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, EVENT_TIME, INGESTED_TIME) > 15;

description: Validates every ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID exists in DIM_CUSTOMER
sql_query: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN DIM_CUSTOMER c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL;

description: Reconciles Stripe gateway gross charge with GL ledger entries
sql_query: SELECT ABS(s.stripe_total - l.ledger_total) AS delta FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) stripe_total FROM stripe_charges) s, (SELECT SUM(amount) ledger_total FROM gl_entries) l WHERE ABS(s.stripe_total - l.ledger_total) > 1.00;

description: Validates table column count and mandatory types match metadata
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DIM_CUSTOMER' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('ID','CREATED_AT') AND IS_NULLABLE = 'YES';

description: Validates that discount percentage never exceeds 50% without executive override
sql_query: SELECT ORDER_ID, DISCOUNT_PCT FROM ORDERS WHERE DISCOUNT_PCT > 50.0 AND OVERRIDE_APPROVED = FALSE;

description: Detects duplicate invoice numbers for identical vendor within same fiscal month
sql_query: SELECT VENDOR_ID, INVOICE_NUM, COUNT(*) FROM INVOICES GROUP BY VENDOR_ID, INVOICE_NUM, FISCAL_MONTH HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

description: Checks that fact table has been updated within the last 24 hours
sql_query: SELECT DATEDIFF(HOUR, MAX(LOAD_TIMESTAMP), GETDATE()) AS hours_since_load FROM FACT_SALES HAVING hours_since_load > 24;
